patterns.title: Orders list page
patterns.question: How does a reader find one order among many?

options.name: Filterable table
options.rationale: Rows scan fast and filters narrow the set without leaving the page.
options.cost: Needs a table composite with filter controls.

options.name: Searchable cards
options.rationale: Cards show each order with room for status and totals.
options.cost: Slow to scan past a few dozen orders.

compact.behaviour: Below 768 pixels the filters stack above the table and the table scrolls horizontally.

extensions.when: The list holds few orders and the reader compares them visually.

patterns.title: Table sorting
patterns.question: How does a reader reorder the rows of a table?

options.name: Sort control in each column header
options.rationale: The control sits where the reader looks when choosing a column.
options.cost: Each sortable header carries a button and a direction label.

options.name: One sort control above the table
options.rationale: One control keeps narrow tables readable.
options.cost: The reader maps the control back to its column.

compact.behaviour: Below 768 pixels headers lose their sort controls and one toolbar above the table sorts.

blazor-web.gap: No Blazor frontend implements the table yet.
